sources.author: Ibn Mujāhid
sources.title: Kitāb al-Sabʿa fī al-qirāʾāt
sources.source_notes: ed. Shawqī Ḍayf (Dār al-Maʿārif). s/a assignment: 347/390 segments carry a surah, 264/390 an ayah (0 from explicit headings). Spot-check: 8/10 correct, 2 off (2:97-98 filed 2:102; 28:34 filed 28:37); the uṣūl chapters inside S1-2 carry the surah only or the nearest farsh entry. Quality: partial.

sources.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
sources.title: al-Ḥujja fī al-qirāʾāt al-sabʿ
sources.edition: د. عبد العال سالم مكرم :: بيروت :: 1401 :: دار الشروق
sources.source_notes: ed. ʿAbd al-ʿĀl Sālim Mukarram. The attribution to Ibn Khālawayh is disputed in the literature. s/a assignment: 483/484 segments carry a surah, 366/484 an ayah (0 from explicit headings). Spot-check: 9/10 correct, 1 off (19:25 filed 19:31). Surah boundaries come partly from running page titles. Quality: good.

sources.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
sources.title: al-Ḥujja li-l-qurrāʾ al-sabʿa
sources.edition: بدر الدين قهوجي - بشير جويجابي :: دار المأمون للتراث - دمشق / بيروت
sources.source_notes: ed. Badr al-Dīn Qahwajī / Bashīr Juwayjābī (Dār al-Maʾmūn). s/a assignment: 2108/2111 segments carry a surah, 1487/2111 an ayah (830 from explicit headings). Spot-check: 10/10 plausible (long grammatical excursuses are filed under the lemma that opened them); 70% of segments carry an ayah. Quality: partial.

sources.author: Ibn Jinnī
sources.title: al-Muḥtasab fī tabyīn wujūh shawādhdh al-qirāʾāt
sources.source_notes: s/a assignment: 506/542 segments carry a surah, 288/542 an ayah (0 from explicit headings). Spot-check: 10/10 plausible but only ~53% of segments carry an ayah (the lemmas are shādhdh readings that often do not match the canonical text). Quality: partial.
